data.name: Banvari
data.gender_notes: Banvari is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Banvari is a Sanskrit name derived from the Goddess of Fortune, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name brings prosperity and wealth. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth, fertility, and auspiciousness. The name Banvari carries the meaning “Goddess of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Banvari usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the Goddess of Fortune bless you with prosperity and happiness.
data.etymology: Banvari belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Banvari total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
